```{r setup, include=FALSE}
rm(list=ls())
library(tidyverse)

library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
library(performance)
library(cowplot)

library(ggridges)

```

```{import data}
data_direct = read.csv("../../data/Light_data.csv") %>% filter(Orientation=="Haut")
  mutate(across(c(Zone, Period, timepoint, Position,Month), as.factor), datetime=ymd_hms(datetime), hm=hour(datetime) + minute(datetime) / 60, Date = as.Date(Date), facteur=log(facteur)) %>% 
  filter(Sat_comb=="No_saturation") %>% 
  distinct(hm,Date,Zone,Position, .keep_all = TRUE)
```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
